headline: DCM Shriram sets October 30 as record date for dividend
hook: Third payout window for DCM Shriram
summary: DCM Shriram Limited has informed the stock exchanges that October 30, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming dividend. Shareholders listed on the company's books by this date will be eligible for the payout. For retail investors holding the stock, this establishes the final timeline required to qualify for the corporate action.
why_it_matters: Qualifying shareholdings must be maintained by October 30 for the dividend.
winners_losers: DCM Shriram shareholders gain / no losers

headline: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals accepts resignation of Aditi Dhar
hook: Leadership change at DCM Shriram unit
summary: DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals has officially accepted the resignation of Aditi Dhar. The company confirmed the departure through a regulatory filing. No specific reason for the resignation or details regarding a successor were provided in the announcement.
why_it_matters: Minor management changes typically have limited impact on stock performance.
